understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by matching the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation to each goal cell, then stepping onto the matching goal.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is performed one tile at a time in the cardinal directions, with walls blocking movement. Shape modifiers cycle the piece's shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90° clockwise. A goal is completed only when all three attributes match simultaneously. Movement consumes stamina; exhausting stamina costs a life and resets stamina, while losing all lives ends the game.
